messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — metering pipeline showing token-count divergence (emitter > billing by ~18% over 10m). Auto-overage rules firing for a subset of customers. On-call: @jamie-eng. Runbook: billing/metering > dedupe-check.

jamie-eng: I'm on it. pulling dashboards + recent deploys. any confirmed customer impacts yet?

sara-billing: 7 customers have auto-overage flags in the last 8m. charges not finalized but flags visible in billing UI. pausing notification send until we triage. prepping a holding message.

alex-sre: quick telemetry: broker reconnects spiked at 15:02 UTC, consumer lag rose briefly. emitter pods show restart loops around then. logs show repeated publish retries. snippet:```
[emitter-1] WARN publish timeout msg 0x9c
[emitter-1] INFO reconnecting and replaying 900 msgs
```

mira-infra: fyi we rolled emitter v2.1 yesterday to canary; health-check threshold lowered which may cause fast restarts on transient broker errors. recommend pausing rollout.

jamie-eng: agreed. mitigation plan: 1) pause emitter rollout, 2) enable billing ingest idempotency check, 3) activate temporary write-through hold for billing ledger, 4) run non-destructive dedupe reconcile. executing now.

jamie-eng: running commands:
```
kubectl -n metering rollout pause deploy/emitter
# enable billing idempotency header check
curl -X POST 'https://admin-api.internal/flags' -d '{"name":"billing.idempotency_check","value":true}'
# hold writes to ledger
curl -X POST 'https://admin-api.internal/flags' -d '{"name":"billing.hold_writes","value":true}'
```

matt-obs: snapshot (10m window):
```
source    | tokens
------------------
emitter   | 1,050,412
ingest    |   890,123
billing   |   756,742
```
emitter tx rate spiked at 15:02 — aligns with canary rollout.

alex-sre: started a quick reconcile job against the ingest buffer (dry-run first) to estimate duplicate ratio. progress: 18% dry-run completed.

sara-billing: pausing emails (+1). if we end up issuing credits we'll need a list of affected accounts and prelim overage amounts. starting a sheet.

mira-infra: paused emitter rollout completed. rolling back canary to previous revision to stop restarts:
```
kubectl -n metering rollout undo deploy/emitter --to-revision=42
```

jamie-eng: billing flags confirmed applied. enabling idempotency acceptance in ingest service now.

matt-obs: dry-run dedupe estimate: ~16% of recent tokens look like duplicates (matching idempotency keys). once idempotency is active we should see ingest->billing alignment improve.

ops_pager: escalation condition: if delta >5% for next 15m, page infra-lead and initiate broker-side replay-block. tagging @infra-lead.

jamie-eng: observed ingest/billing delta down to ~3% after enabling idempotency and rollback. reconcile job switched to apply mode; de-duped ~120k tokens (non-destructive).

sara-billing: holding off notifications. if charges were already posted, I will draft a credit plan and customer note. estimating affected customers and amounts now.

matt-obs: metrics stable for 10m; delta within SLA tolerance. continuing monitoring for full retention window.

infra-lead: thanks team — good call on rollback. please include timeline and decision points in postmortem. we may want a guardrail to prevent future canary health thresholds from triggering restarts on transient broker issues.

jamie-eng: will file postmortem and include remediation (deploy guard, idempotency as default, broker backpressure tuning). owners: jamie-eng (tech), mira-infra (deploy safety), sara-billing (customer comms), matt-obs (monitoring).

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated — monitoring. Runbook ref: billing/metering > idempotency & rollback. Incident duration ~22m. Please create a postmortem: /pm create billing-token-replay-rollback
